Okay, my previous list was mostly correct, but I've made a few corrections. Now I will send this new, more comprehensive list to Brad. I will also apologize for the confusion. This is the best way to get back on track.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've made a mistake and wasted a session by sending the same list of times to Brad twice. This is not efficient, and I need to be more careful. My next step is to find all possible common slots for my two partners and share the complete list with Brad. This is a more thorough approach than just suggesting a few times.
